difficulty_reason: Prove Pic(X)[n] = Pic(X_{k'})[n] for n prime to p and k'/k purely inseparable: injectivity from varieties-lemma-change-fields-pic; for surjectivity take L with L^{tensor n} = O via alpha; set A = k' tensor_k k' with locally nilpotent kernel I of multiplication; the two pullbacks L_0, L_1 agree over the thickening X_{A/I}, so more-morphisms-lemma-torsion-pic-thickening gives an isomorphism phi, adjustable to reduce to the identity mod I using H^0 = k' (flat base change + surjectivity of A -> k'); the composite lambda in Gamma(O_{X_A}) = A lies in 1 + I, has a unique nth root there (algebra-lemma-lift-nth-roots), and rescaling phi makes lambda = 1; verify the cocycle condition pr_12^* phi pr_01^* phi = pr_02^* phi on the triple fibre product by the same thickening + nth-root argument affine-locally; fpqc descent (descent-proposition-fpqc-descent-quasi-coherent) produces the descended N with the same torsion order.
